Shape Sort Rules

A sorting puzzle with shapes instead of colours: move the stones until every tube holds just one shape.

The rules

Tubes
Every tube holds up to four stones. At the start the stones are mixed up and two tubes are empty.
A move
Tap a tube: its top stone is marked, together with any stones of the same shape right below it. Then tap another tube. The stones go there if that tube is empty or has the same shape on top - as many as fit. Tap the marked tube again to put the stones back down.
The goal
The puzzle is solved when every tube is either empty or holds four stones of the same shape.
The shapes
Circle, square, triangle, star, heart, cross, diamond and moon. They differ in their outline; some are filled and some are drawn as an outline, but that is only an extra help.
Levels
Easy: 4 shapes in 6 tubes. Medium: 6 shapes in 8 tubes. Hard: 8 shapes in 10 tubes. On narrow screens the tubes are shown in two rows.
Undo, Shuffle, Hint
Undo takes back as many moves as you like. Shuffle deals a new puzzle. Hint marks two tubes: move the top stones from the first to the second. Every puzzle has been checked to be solvable; if you get stuck, the hint says so and you can undo a few moves.

Example
